definitions.explanation: A board displaying information, often a shop name or advertisement.
A person or thing that represents or symbolizes something.
Used in expressions referring to the end of business hours.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}の{看板|かんばん}が{新|あたら}しくなった。
{彼女|かのじょ}はこの{会社|かいしゃ}の{看板|かんばん}{女優|じょゆう}だ。
examples.english: She is this company's leading actress.

examples.japanese: もうすぐ{看板|かんばん}の{時間|じかん}です。

notes:
{看板|かんばん} has multiple meanings related to representation and display.

Common expressions:
- {看板|かんばん}を{出|だ}す (to put up a sign; to open for business)
- {看板|かんばん}を{下|お}ろす (to close down a business)
- {看板|かんばん}{商品|しょうひん} (flagship product)
- {看板|かんばん}{娘|むすめ}/{看板|かんばん}{女優|じょゆう} (poster girl/leading actress)
- {看板|かんばん}に{偽|いつわ}りなし (truth in advertising)

Business/manufacturing:
- かんばん{方式|ほうしき} (Kanban system - Toyota's just-in-time manufacturing method)

Note on closing time:
- {看板|かんばん}だ (It's closing time - from the practice of taking down signs at closing)
